summary: Crypto markets are broadly quiet and mixed today, with Bitcoin near $61,151 and 64 of the 100 largest tokens higher over the prior 24 hours.[4] The broader backdrop remains risk-sensitive after Bitcoin’s recent two-year low and concerns about AI valuations, borrowing costs, and regulatory risks.[2][5] Michaël van de Poppe has highlighted improving Bitcoin weekly-candle strength, but the available evidence does not establish fresh same-day conviction across the requested analysts.[9]
